22. It is evident from the above that Khawja Sadderuddin, the single major shareholder of the company who used to run the company has been out of Bangladesh before the day of promulgation of the PO No.16 of 1972 and there was none from Dienfa Limited in the country from 1972 to 1989 to supervise or manage the property in question. Although the respondent tries to establish that Khawja Sadderuddin worked as Secretary to the company till 3-3-1972, but it does not create a conclusive presumption that Khawja Sadderuddin stayed in Bangladesh till 3-3-1972 rather it gives rise to a reasonable inference that he left the country before 1972 after holding the Annual General Meeting of the Company in 1971 and died on 26-5-1985 while staying abroad. 

 18. Since the property has been listed under section 5(1) of the Ordinance as abandoned property and the said list has been published in the official Gazette, the claimant to the property i.e. respondent No. 1 was required to dislodge statutory presumption as under section 5(2) of the Ordinance that the property in question was not an abandoned property and that the same has been wrongly listed as abandoned property.
